messages:
Priya S.: Heads-up: new billing/quota changes go live July 22. Short summary: tiered soft rate limits, a 7-day overage forgiveness window for hosted metered customers, consolidated monthly CSV invoice export, and trial credits will expire after 90 days (grandfathering for credits issued before rollout). Doc: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/july22 :loudspeaker:
Billing Bot: Published: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/july22 (CSV schema + sample rows)
DevRel: Quick Q: what counts as an overage event? single large burst or sustained above-plan usage?
Priya S.: Overage triggers if usage exceeds plan commitment over the billing period. The 7-day grace is for short-term spikes where usage exceeds expected by up to X% (details in the doc). Sustained overages will be billed after the grace window ends.
Mark D.: Will rate-limit responses include headers so SDKs can retry more intelligently?
Priya S.: Yes 1 adding `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Reset`. Eng-Platform, please add guidance for SDK backoff patterns.
Eng-Platform: Noted. We'll add header parsing and an example retry snippet in JavaScript and Python. ETA for PRs: July 15.
Legal: Confirming dedicated/reserved customers keep their committed QoS and billing terms?
Priya S.: Correct. Reserved/Dedicated plans are unaffected; guarantees remain. The changes apply to hosted metered plans only.
Support Bot: Action: update KB articles for credit expiry, overage disputes, and canned responses.
DevRel: Can we get an example CSV header for invoices to update our accounting export?
Billing Bot: Sample header in the doc: `invoice_id,customer_id,period_start,period_end,total_amount,token_count,embedding_units,overage_amount,credits_applied` plus a sample row.
Mark D.: How will overage charges appear on invoices? Single invoice with line items?
Priya S.: Single monthly invoice. Overage appears as a separate line item; credits applied afterward. Examples included in CSV samples.
DevRel: Anything for customer communications? we should prep email + release note copy.
Priya S.: Marketing draft in #marketing-drafts. Suggested short blurb: "We're updating billing controls to reduce surprise rejections during short spikes and to provide clearer invoice exports. No immediate charges will be applied during the 7-day grace window. See the FAQ for details."
Support Bot: Scheduled internal AMA: July 18 10:00 PT in #all-hands for Finance + Eng Q&A.
Priya S.: Thanks everyone 2 please review the doc and drop questions in the AMA or here.
